metadata.title: ceramic-composition-parser 0.2.0: code, result records and manuscript sources for "Refusing Ambiguous Composition Notation: An Auditable Parser, a Guarded Normalization Stage and a Catalogue of Notation Hazards"

creators.name: Imran
creators.affiliation: Interdisciplinary Research Center for Intelligent Manufacturing & Robotics, King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals, Dhahran, Saudi Arabia

metadata.description: Release 0.2.0 of the ceramic-composition-parser package and the complete evaluation behind the revised manuscript 'Refusing Ambiguous Composition Notation: An Auditable Parser, a Guarded Normalization Stage and a Catalogue of Notation Hazards'. Contents: the parser (shared lexical screen with 15 controlled refusal flags, deterministic grammar, pymatgen cross-check), the frozen v0.1.0 parser for comparison, the JSON Schema record model 1.1.0, the unit-semantics layer, the test suite, the 51 hand-written benchmark strings with expected amounts, per-string outcomes of five parser configurations on 22,967 literature composition strings (Kononova et al. text-mined synthesis releases, fetched by script at a pinned commit, not redistributed), the notation-hazard catalogue, a stratified sample for independent expert annotation, generated figures, number macros and the LaTeX sources of the manuscript and ESI. The optional normalization stage is in normalization_stage/: its two modules (in code/) and the post hoc name-stoichiometry guard, the pre-registrations, the SHA-256 digests recorded before each held-out run, the design and one-shot scoring scripts, the per-string outcomes and McNemar tests of both held-out runs, the provisional hand-check labels of every recovered string, the post hoc guard diagnostic, and the script that writes the stage's number macros; it also holds the labelling guide, blank sheets and analysis script for the independent expert annotation. The file set with SHA-256 digests is listed in MANIFEST.csv.
